title: Stop measuring inside a filled world
summary: Let your own heart, work, and remembrance come back into view. Let this stay near the next choice: keep this in front of you: comparison weakens when the world is seen as already filled.
takeaway: Let contentment quiet the need to compare.
lifeApplication: When envy rises, step away from the screen and return the mind to one truthful task already in your hands today.

source.shortMeaning: The Divine already fills every form the mind keeps comparing.
source.lifeApplication: When comparison starts, widen the gaze until scarcity loses its grip.
